summary: Tested Apple App Store rejection fixes for PepTrack Pro. Verified: Calculator disclaimer modal, FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY labels, Target Amount/Suggested Units labels, Google/Apple sign-in buttons, Help & FAQ link, Support page, and References button. Most features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: All Apple App Store rejection fixes have been implemented correctly
Calculator disclaimer modal appears on first visit with checkbox acceptance requirement
Calculator uses 'Target Amount' and 'Suggested Units' labels instead of 'Dose'
Profile page shows both Google and Apple sign-in buttons (Apple uses web fallback on non-iOS)
Research page has 'View References & Citations' button with categorized sources modal
Profile has 'Help & FAQ' link that navigates to Support page with FAQ section
